Компанії більш цікаво через місяць запускати новий потік з такими ж наївними людьми. Вони говорять що на прикладі свого магазину покажуть як розвинути магазин, але приклад їх магазину це просто посміховисько GreenStarTools, де навіть вони не показали продажів. Блок з реклами це взагалі жахіття, Влад Мальчевський не розкриває все з нуля і по крокам, він показує все на прикладі якби їх клієнтів, навіть не на прикладі цього ж горемагазину GreenStarTools, а його робота з компʼютерною мишкою викликає нудоту і запаморочення від того як вправно він скролить вгору вниз. Це чистої води інфобізнес який працює на потоці і більше всього що коментарі тут теж замовлені чи проплачені. З мого потоку немає задоволених людей. Нікому не рекомендую даний курс. Ті магазини, які вони розбирають в своїх відео, це не дропшиперські магазини, так як люди які створюють магазини на Shopify не всі дропшиппери. Не думайте що ви почнете перепродавати товар з Аліекспрес американцям в 3 рази дорожче, вони розуміються в цінах краще чим Дмитро та Влад і лишньої копійки точно не витратять. Якщо вам хочеться дуже в дропшиппінг на Shopify краще купіть будь який курс на Udemy в 20 разів дешевше.

Владислав просто випробовує вістибюлярний апарат студентів і все робить з такою швидкістю що потрібно по 10 разів зупиняти відео. Ви не даєте глибинних знань, про що ви взагалі говорите. delivery_quality.snippet:
В липні 2024 року вирішила пройти курс. Придбала курс з підтримкою і дуже пошкудувала. Курс записаний к 2022 році повно старої інформації, яка не відповідає реаліям сьогодення. Вже на початку перших модулів вас зустрінуть труднощі у створені магазину. Ви будете дивитися урок, а повторити не зможете тому що інтерфейс шопіфай зараз зовсім інший. Ви будете витрачати час не на те щоб поглибитися у навчання, ви будете витрачати час на те, щоб знайти ту чи іншу кнопку. Підтримка від Артура малоінформативна, куратор зовсім не зацікавлений в вашому результаті, так, як і сама школа. На курсі в кожному модулі на вас чекають додаткові витрати на купу інших додатків без яких ви далі рухатися не зможете. Я вважаю це дуже не порядним не озвучити це на вебінарах, на котрих організатори продають цей курс. Підписок багато, і набігає досить немала сума. Далі вибір продукту і реклама там свої сюрпризи та секрети. Спочатку вам треба обарти продукт проаналізувати його, а це витратити чимало часу і таких товарів має бути від 5 і фактияно в сліпу (тому що лише покаже тест , чи ви вгадали) без гарантій запускати га нього рекламу на три дні лише тесту до 150$ на один товар, в там як пощастить…

Вирішувати кожному, але я підсумую.

1. В курсі купа старої інформації, вона можливо і робоча, але вчитися максимаааально важко і дратівливо.

2. Дуже багато треба купувати різних додатків, підписок і всього іншого. Чималі додаткові витрати про які вам не скажуть, це буде сюрпризом в кожному модулі.

3. Підтримка кураторства ні про що, дуже слабка та коротка ( всього місяць , може зроблять більше бо був кіпіш з цього приводу) на вихідних та після 18:00 чи 19:00 не відповідають. В період відключення світла було дуже важко і вони за це відповідальності не несуть. Ну це зрозуміло, але і студенти не винні, вони заручники положення.

4. Вибір продукту та запуск це лотерея.

Якщо у вас є купа часу та грошей в прямому сенсі слова КУПА цих ресурсів можна розважаться. Якщо ні то подумайте 100 раз.

Дуже не задоволена цим досвідом, найгірше навчання, яке я проходила , але маємо що маємо.

Будьте обережні та перед покупкою читайте відгуки! Всім миру!

delivery_quality.snippet:
I wish I had taken more time to read all the one-star reviews before deciding to work with this company. I hired them to design a website for my holistic acupuncture practice, expecting a truly custom design aligned with my brand and business model.

These guys are not web developers, and they do not know much about web development. The final product did not reflect what was promised. The term “custom design” was used in a way that did not match the actual deliverable. Beginning with a blank Wix template and applying minimal stylistic changes does not constitute custom web design. There also appeared to be a significant disconnect between holistic medicine branding and conventional biomedical or corporate aesthetics. The overall tone, imagery, and execution felt misaligned with the clearly stated focus of my practice.

When I expressed concern that the design did not reflect my vision or business identity, the feedback I received framed the issue as a “creative shift” rather than acknowledging a potential misunderstanding of the brand direction. Additionally, certain requirements - such as the need for me to independently supply stock imagery - were not clearly disclosed prior to purchase.

When concerns were raised, I expected collaborative problem-solving and professional dialogue. Instead, communication centered on contractual defenses and even threats rather than addressing the underlying design misalignment.

This review reflects my documented experience so that others can make informed decisions. Client retention is best achieved through transparency, alignment with client vision, and professional execution.

It's too bad you're going to lose clients after the way you treated me - they have every right to understand others’ experiences before investing their money.

*** Responding to their comment down below that is not factual or true ***

The homepage was not delivered within the stated timeline (actually had I not fired you, it probably would have taken many more weeks to complete it), and when it was finally presented, it did not reflect the information or direction I had provided. I was genuinely surprised by the quality of what was delivered, especially given that it was presented as aligned with my business and vision.

There was no clear disclosure upfront that clients would be responsible for sourcing stock images and effectively designing the website themselves. That was the service I believe I was paying for.

When I raised concerns about the misalignment in color palette, tone, and overall aesthetic, I expected collaborative problem-solving. Instead, the responsibility was shifted back onto me. At that point, I chose to end the working relationship, as it did not make sense to continue investing time and energy into a process that was not producing results. The delays and repeated revisions were costing me time and money.

I ultimately initiated a formal dispute due to the poor quality of the work delivered and the denial of my refund request.

Threatening with arbitration and defamation in response to legitimate client concerns was both delusional and toxic. When a client raises legitimate concerns, the focus should be on resolution - not intimidation. And honestly, why did you think that it would work? That's just disgusting attitude. I do not have the time or energy for business relationships that create unnecessary stress and drama.

I'm not even surprised to read their generic response to my comment. I took the time to read through all their responses to 1 star reviews. Quite laughable honestly to continue to defend your lack of professionalism and poor quality of work.The overall experience was not professional - they think about only money and not the client.

You never want to be working with a company so out of touch with reality and so malignant. Literally just be normal, it's not necessary to be so hostile to someone whose money you're taking.

Look elsewhere.

I engaged Jives Media after a three-month search for a suitable Google Ads agency, initially attracted by their promises of expertise and a tailored approach. Unfortunately, our experience was extremely disappointing, and the results did not reflect the $4,700 per month we invested in their services.

From the start, there were significant issues with their approach and recommendations. One of our key concerns was the suggestion to change our main campaign’s bid strategy from Target Impression Share to Maximise Conversions without conducting an A/B test. As someone experienced in Google Ads, I know that changing a bid strategy is one of the most significant shifts you can make within a campaign, and it should never be done without proper testing. Jay described this change as "baby steps," but the suggestion revealed a clear disconnect in understanding and a concerning lack of expertise from the team.

Adding to this, the team recommended pausing bids for the search term “eyelash extension course,” which is literally the core product we sell. This recommendation was not only baffling but showed an evident lack of understanding of our business and goals. We had expected a partner with a sound strategy aligned with our business needs, but these suggestions showed the opposite.

Our concerns were repeatedly ignored or mishandled, leading to a further breakdown of trust. I specifically requested to speak directly with Jay, the CEO, to address these strategy concerns and discuss his team’s experience with accounts of our scale. Instead, Jay brought additional team members, preventing an open discussion about these issues. The lack of regard for our requests as a new client left us feeling undervalued and sidelined.

Further adding to the frustration, Jives Media regularly took days to respond to our emails, even as a new client. In an industry where timing and communication are critical, this lack of responsiveness only deepened our dissatisfaction.

On the technical side, Jives Media was contractually responsible for conducting market analysis and competitive research during their onboarding process. Instead, we were asked to provide our own list of competitors and revenue data, which they could have easily accessed within our Google Ads account. This failure to carry out basic responsibilities reinforced our view that they were not doing the necessary work to manage our account effectively.

Additionally, when it came to landing page optimisations, I had made it very clear that 90% of our traffic came from mobile users. Despite this, we received recommendations based solely on desktop performance. This oversight showed a clear lack of attention to detail and was another instance of them not fully comprehending or accommodating our business needs.

After expressing our dissatisfaction and intent to part ways, we were met with legal involvement from their team. I had hoped for an open conversation directly with Jay, business owner to business owner, to resolve matters amicably, but instead, I received an email from their billing department with legal threats. This approach was both unexpected and disappointing, especially after I had clearly stated in writing that we did not intend to share our experience publicly.

In short, Jives Media’s strategy, responsiveness, and lack of attention to detail did not reflect the professional service they promoted during initial discussions. For $4,700 a month, we expected a knowledgeable, proactive partner, yet the reality fell far short of that standard. Businesses looking for a Google Ads partner should proceed with caution, as our experience highlighted serious issues with both their strategy and client service.

Unfortunately, our experience was extremely disappointing, and the results did not reflect the $4,700 per month we invested in their services.

From the start, there were significant issues with their approach and recommendations. One of our key concerns was the suggestion to change our main campaign’s bid strategy from Target Impression Share to Maximise Conversions without conducting an A/B test. As someone experienced in Google Ads, I know that changing a bid strategy is one of the most significant shifts you can make within a campaign, and it should never be done without proper testing. Jay described this change as "baby steps," but the suggestion revealed a clear disconnect in understanding and a concerning lack of expertise from the team.

Adding to this, the team recommended pausing bids for the search term “eyelash extension course,” which is literally the core product we sell. This recommendation was not only baffling but showed an evident lack of understanding of our business and goals. We had expected a partner with a sound strategy aligned with our business needs, but these suggestions showed the opposite.

Our concerns were repeatedly ignored or mishandled, leading to a further breakdown of trust. I specifically requested to speak directly with Jay, the CEO, to address these strategy concerns and discuss his team’s experience with accounts of our scale. Instead, Jay brought additional team members, preventing an open discussion about these issues. The lack of regard for our requests as a new client left us feeling undervalued and sidelined.

Further adding to the frustration, Jives Media regularly took days to respond to our emails, even as a new client. In an industry where timing and communication are critical, this lack of responsiveness only deepened our dissatisfaction.

On the technical side, Jives Media was contractually responsible for conducting market analysis and competitive research during their onboarding process. Instead, we were asked to provide our own list of competitors and revenue data, which they could have easily accessed within our Google Ads account. This failure to carry out basic responsibilities reinforced our view that they were not doing the necessary work to manage our account effectively.

Additionally, when it came to landing page optimisations, I had made it very clear that 90% of our traffic came from mobile users. Despite this, we received recommendations based solely on desktop performance. This oversight showed a clear lack of attention to detail and was another instance of them not fully comprehending or accommodating our business needs.

After expressing our dissatisfaction and intent to part ways, we were met with legal involvement from their team. I had hoped for an open conversation directly with Jay, business owner to business owner, to resolve matters amicably, but instead, I received an email from their billing department with legal threats. This approach was both unexpected and disappointing, especially after I had clearly stated in writing that we did not intend to share our experience publicly.

In short, Jives Media’s strategy, responsiveness, and lack of attention to detail did not reflect the professional service they promoted during initial discussions. For $4,700 a month, we expected a knowledgeable, proactive partner, yet the reality fell far short of that standard. Businesses looking for a Google Ads partner should proceed with caution, as our experience highlighted serious issues with both their strategy and client service.

Працювала з RoApp близько пів року. За цей час ми зіткнулися з серйозними технічними проблемами, які напряму вплинули на роботу та фінанси компанії.

Інтеграція з Viber регулярно відключалася сама по собі. Менеджери виявляли це випадково  - коли заходили написати клієнтам і бачили, що канал не працює. Повідомлення від клієнтів відповідно не надходили коли вайбер був від'єднаний. За пів року таких відключень було близько 8.

Через це ми втрачали звернення, виникали конфліктні ситуації з батьками, страждала репутація та конверсія. Бізнес ніс прямі фінансові збитки.

Друга проблема - відсутність звукових сповіщень. Менеджери не отримували звукові сповіщення про нові повідомлення, не могли оперативно реагувати на заявки. Для компанії, де швидкість відповіді критично важлива, це неприпустимо.

Я неодноразово зверталася до техпідтримки. Відповіді були однакові: “завтра”, “післязавтра”, “наступного тижня”. Проблеми не вирішувалися місяцями. При цьому нам повідомляли, що система працює коректно.

Ми були змушені перейти на іншу CRM-систему, і всі ці проблеми зникли.

Я не вимагала жодної компенсації фінансових збитків, яких компанія зазнала через збої. Я лише попросила повернути кошти за невикористаний, вже оплачений авансовий період. У поверненні грошей мені відмовили.

Висновок простий: ніколи не співпрацювати із цією компанією та не чекати на вирішення проблем, одразу змінювати систему і все

deadline_missed.snippet:
Proceed with Caution: Ethical and capability concerns.

I hired DDNYC for an e-commerce website project that was paid for in full in May 2025. This followed a positive experience working with them on branding in 2024, which is why I trusted them with the website build.

The website project has experienced significant delays, unresolved functionality, and ongoing execution issues that remain present today (which they claim to be resolved). Core features have not functioned as intended, and the site continues to require fixes that are now attempted to be addressed by a new development team willing to step in and stabilize the platform.

Throughout the delays, work was repeatedly described as complimentary due to missed timelines and internal development challenges. As issues escalated, DDNYC later attempted to retroactively re-characterize more than a year of prior work as billable, including referencing an older branding scope that had already been completed and paid for in 2024.

Most concerning, the agency is currently refusing to release my website for transfer to a new team unless "outstanding items"  are addressed. This has directly disrupted my business operations and raises serious ethical concerns about professionalism, transparency, and client treatment once a project encounters difficulty.

For additional context, I’ve documented my experience in detail on the Clutch platform. Based on my experience, e-commerce brands should be extremely clear about deliverables, timelines, billing practices, ownership of assets, and exit terms before engaging this agency.

**UPDATE** BEWARE

I feel I have to warn others to stay clear of this company. As of December 16, 2025, my website has still not been released to me despite full payment under a signed statement of work, and the website still has errors that have not been resolved. All invoices issued to me have been paid; no additional invoices have been provided, yet access and transfer are still being withheld.

Based on what has happened with my website, I do not believe this company operates in an ethical or trustworthy way.

*UPDATE– Thank you to all of the developers and designers who have reached out to me personally. This entire experience has been an absolute nightmare. In my experience, the unprofessional and abhorrent behavior I have seen and been subjected to in connection with a failed contract is not what any business owner should have to go through. Do not be blinded by who DDNYC has worked with as clients; please save your company a headache and choose another vendor.
deadline_missed.reasoning: Significant repeated delays on website project.
deadline_missed.quote: The website project has experienced significant delays, unresolved functionality, and ongoing execution issues
